$Comment: A minimal template role shaped exactly the way a placement-backing template has to be shaped: every key NpcRoleGenerator can override is declared in Parameters and bound into the body with Compute. Copy this shape into your own template and keep the parameter NAMES, since the generated variant addresses them by name.

NameTranslationKey.Description: Translation key for NPC name display.

Hint.Description: Translation key for the press-F prompt.

Weapons.Description: NPC weapons (and other main hand items).

DefaultOffHandSlot.Description: Default off-hand item slot. -1 for nothing.
